input_ref: explore | Insurance advocate: what do I say before I quote a cost

output.reason: No single unit fully answers this. U-BEN-COST-001-01 says to mention today's plan record and then read the Legal verbatim block before any dollar amount, but it does not include that block's wording. U-BEN-COST-001-02 has the verbatim disclaimer but does not say it comes before the quote or include the opening step. A full answer would need both units, which is not allowed. U-BEN-COST-001-06 covers referral checks, not what to say.
